title: AssistantAgent should raise warning when reflection_on_tool_use=True and model family is Claude
body:
In addition, the warning message should explain how to perform reflection on tool usage with anthropic model client. 

It should be based on the text termination condition: #5732, and point to the relevant part of the documentation. 

> @lspinheiro @victordibia I think it is possible in the future Anthropic will support `tool_choice=None` just like OpenAI, or support not requiring the tools field when there is tool usage in the message history. 
> 
> Before that happens, in `AssistantAgent` we can use `model_info` of the model client to determine if the model belongs to the Claude family. In that case, we raise an exception when `reflect_on_tool_use=True`, in the constructor. 
> 
> So basically an `AssistantAgent` won't support reflection on tool usage when the model is Claude.  

 _Originally posted by @ekzhu in [#5675](https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/issues/5675#issuecomment-2685983779)_

linked_prs.title: fix: warn when using reflection on tool use with Claude models

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves LLM provider usage (Anthropic's Claude model) and tool invocation behavior (reflection on tool usage). It discusses compatibility and configuration issues related to the agent's operation with specific LLM models, which aligns with the definition of an agent issue.
